title: Max Learns Why We Must Listen

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's a sunny day at the Tiny Sparks school yard!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Hi, friends! It's me, Max! Today is a special day!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Professor Hoot has a treasure hunt for us!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hello, everyone! Somewhere in the yard, I hid a treasure box.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: To find it, you must listen carefully to my three clues.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: We're ready, Professor Hoot!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Ready, steady, go!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clue number one: go to the yellow slide...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But look! A butterfly flies by... and Max stops listening.

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Ooh! A butterfly! Come back, butterfly!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clue number two: then hop three times, and...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max runs, and runs, and runs... the wrong way!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oops! Max bumps into the swing. Bonk!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Uh-oh. Where's the slide? What were the clues?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: I didn't hear them. I was chasing the butterfly.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max feels confused, and a little bit sad.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Hmm. What did Max forget to do?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: He forgot to listen!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! Max needs bigger ears!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hee hee! No, Leo! His ears are big already!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Max, listening is a super power. Let me show you how, in three easy steps.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step one: Stop. Keep your body still, like a statue.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you stop like a statue? Freeze!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step two: Look. Look at the friend who is talking.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you look at me? Big eyes!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step three: Listen. Open your ears, and hear every word.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you cup your ears? Ready to listen!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Stop. Look. Listen. I can do it!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's practise with a listening game! Listen to Professor Hoot!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Touch your nose!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Great listening!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clap two times!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Clap, clap! Well done!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Jump like a bunny!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Boing, boing! I can do it!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now pat your head, and rub your tummy!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Oops! I'm patting my tummy! Hee hee!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Wiggle your fingers! Wiggle, wiggle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Wiggly fingers! Great job!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And now... freeze like a statue!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: I'm a statue! I'm listening!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, let's try the treasure hunt again!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Stop. Look. Listen. I'm ready!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clue number one: go to the yellow slide.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh! Here comes the butterfly again!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Bye, butterfly! I'm listening now!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max goes to the yellow slide. Wheee!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clue number two: hop three times.

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: One! Two! Three!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Clue number three: look under the red bucket.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where is the red bucket? Can you find it?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Here it is! I lift the bucket... and...

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: The treasure box! Woof, woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Inside the box... shiny stickers for everyone!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hooray! A star sticker for me!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And a rocket sticker for me!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: A honey pot sticker! Yum!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: I found it, because I listened!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Well done, Max! Listening helps us learn, and play, and stay safe.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When we listen, we know what to do!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who do YOU listen to? Your mum? Your dad? Your teacher?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember the three listening steps!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Stop!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Look!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Listen!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Stop! Look! Listen!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Quiz time! Are you ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why did Max get lost?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: He chased the butterfly, and didn't listen!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is step one?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Stop! Keep your body still.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where was the treasure?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Under the red bucket!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Does Max need bigger ears?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: No! He just needs to listen! Silly me!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Thanks for listening, friends! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
